queue.claim: InsightFace ArcFace ONNX contract: 112x112 RGB input, (px-127.5)/127.5 unless the graph begins with Sub/Mul nodes, 512-d un-normalised output, and arcface_dst template [[38.2946,51.6963],[73.5318,51.5014],[56.0252,71.7366],[41.5493,92.3655],[70.7299,92.2041]].

Cosine threshold anchors: OpenCV FaceRecognizerSF sample uses cosine 0.363 / L2 1.128 for SFace; deepface ArcFace default is about 0.68 cosine distance (similarity about 0.32); practitioners use about 0.28-0.45 for buffalo_l; good-quality genuine pairs score about 0.5-0.8.

MICA's training loss is only a masked (region-weighted) L1 geometry loss on FLAME vertices with no ArcFace identity term. ArcFace (insightface, possibly the antelopev2/Glint360K R100) is the encoder. The 24% improvement refers to a metric evaluation whose benchmark naming is unclear.
